correctness.rationale: An independent replay (/workspace/review-evidence/3-replay.py, passing the frozen certificate.json path as its sole argument) regenerated each independence complex by enumerating all vertex masks against explicit Hamming-distance-one edges. It recovered 742/785/837/901/981 nonempty faces and verified the 367 pivot pairs, all 2816 Hasse incidences by DFS acyclicity, and exactly one vertex and seven 3-face critical cells. Thus the intact complex has a CW model of seven 3-cells attached to a point. The first fault fills e*L with intersection (∂e)*L; the replay verified all eight strict free coface pairs taking L onto the three-edge matching independence sphere. The attached S³ is the four-edge octahedral sphere. The replay checked its signed integral boundary vanishes and {0,6,11,13} occurs with coefficient one and has no proper coface. Its dual cochain is closed and evaluates to one, yielding a primitive element. Hurewicz for the two-connected wedge and the unimodular change of basis on that wedge show the cofiber removes exactly one sphere (and the natural homology map is split onto). The replay verified the frozen collapse pairs for K₂→K₁, K₃→K₂, K₄→K₃, counts 26, 32, 40, by checking the unique strict coface and exact end complex. The 24 actions realizing S₄ carry a flag A⊆B to the canonical flag of sizes |A|,|B|; translations and coordinate permutations carry the canonical matching to all eight classes. This proves actual relative collapses for the claimed inclusions, including equal sets by the empty sequence. No extension to arbitrary matchings, larger cubes, or equivariant homotopy type is inferred. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed; no field Betti number is used to establish the integral result.

evidence: Adamaszek gives ΣInd(G−N[e])→Ind(G)→Ind(G−e) and the contractible-residue equivalence as Lemma 2.1(c), along with graph folds in Lemma 2.3.
Jonsson's cross-cycle criterion is precisely an induced matching together with a maximal independent transversal; this covers the cycle detection mechanism, not the effects of successive deletions.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These tools apply here only after establishing the particular first link and later residual collapsibility. For instance, the next-fault residual on the eight vertices consists of two adjacent centers with three leaves on each, with some of the three leaf-to-leaf matched edges missing. A missing matched edge gives a pendant on each side; their neighborhoods are contained in those of all the other same-side leaves. Folding those leaves gives a path P₄ whose independence complex collapses to a point, and lifting the link collapse along the new edge gives a relative collapse. The general theorems alone do not specify this matched geometry or the killed class.
